plain_english_policy: This bill is a targeted **one-time appropriation** of $855,861 to Talladega College for fiscal year 2010–2011. It reflects a policy direction toward **conditional state funding for historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs)** in Alabama, with an emphasis on accountability through financial transparency and performance reporting.
